text:
hannah: Quick thread to align Q3 Private deploy roadmap goals: reduce upgrade risk and give netops clear VPC presets.
ivan: Field asks: smaller default payload for airgap, and a migration safety net so CIDRs never shift silently.
julia: Recommend deliverables: (A) modular installer bundles (core + optional netops modules), (B) 3 routing presets with terraform snippets, (C) safe-upgrade pipeline with canary + dry-run migrations.
kube-bot: CI flake: private-upgrade-e2e#321 failed step 'migration-dryrun' on 2024-06-10. Error: tenant-mapping-unresolved.
kevin: For bundles: enforce signed manifests and optional delta patches to keep default <400MB. Offline decrypt using customer KMS blobs.
lina: Presets: "nat-peer", "bgp-handshake", "relay-proxy". Each preset should include networking preflight checks and example peering policies.
mohit: Upgrade safety: preflight (kernel/glibc/containerd check), migration dry-run, probabilistic canary (5/20/100%), and explicit rollback CLI. Also surface runtime KV-cache drain hooks.
hannah: Launch gates proposal: 1) signed bundles + KMS support, 2) migration dry-run passes in 3 topologies, 3) canary rollout automation with auto-fallback, 4) documented rollback SLAs and runbook.
ivan: Small tooling idea: migration assistant CLI to map old->new tenant CIDRs and output a human-reviewable plan. Low effort, high value.
julia: Owners: Bundles -> Kevin + Lina. Presets -> Julia + Ivan. Upgrade safety -> Mohit + Runtime team. Comms -> Hannah.
kube-bot: Created issue PRIV-Q3-LOCKBOX-77 and linked to thread 5061237890.
kevin: I'll prototype a signed-bundle schema and delta patcher by Thu. Lina will draft terraform snippets.
mohit: I'll spec the dry-run checks this week and loop in eng-runtime for KV cache constraints.
hannah: Thanks everyone. Ping here for blockers; will set a 30min sync for Friday to review prototypes. :rocket:
